name: Reindsurm Amurusa
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.
